name: Allegedly
title: Unisex Cat – Allegedly Socks
story: Allegedly: cat socks for the cat owner whose tuxedo cat has just knocked an ornament off the tree and admits nothing, a stocking stuffer for the cat mom, cat dad or roommate wrapped for Christmas.

The print is a black and white cat with a raised paw and a smug look, sitting on a braided rug under a branch of pine and berries, beside a shattered red ornament, over the single word ALLEGEDLY. in faded red slab capitals, on cream. The art matches our Allegedly crewneck, so the socks make a set with the sweatshirt.

Every cat owner has seen that face: the one that says the tree fell over on its own. One word covers the whole story, so the joke reads from across the room, in the living room or on the couch with the cat sitting on your feet. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed to order, an easy gift for the person who already owns a mug, a tote and a lint roller covered in cat hair.
joke_a: Every cat owner has watched a cat bat an ornament off the tree and then look innocent. The Allegedly Socks from Graphic Tees Co. print that guilty cat on the leg beside the broken ornament, with one word of denial, so the joke reads on the couch and under the tree on Christmas morning.
ink: the red, black and cream print
